_comment: Shipped preset for Meshy Multi-Image to Model. Chain: LoadImage #10-13 -> MeshyMultiImageToModelNode #1 -> File3DFirst #62 (GLB then FBX) -> SaveGLB #3. Stage images.image0..image3 map 1:1 onto Meshy images.image0..image3 (API requires ≥2). Stage image4 unused.
label: Meshy Multi
description: Meshy Multi-Image to Model (API). 2–4 reference images → mesh (GLB/FBX via File3DFirst). image0+image1 required; image2/image3 optional. Stage socket names match the Meshy node. Binds seed / pbr.
